# News {.unnumbered}

Each released version of the book has an entry here that says what changed since the version before it, so you can check whether something you read has since been corrected. Earlier versions stay online and can be opened from the version menu in the sidebar.

## In preparation {.unnumbered}

What the next release will contain: everything in version 0.1 plus the changes below.

Changes since version 0.1:

- 30 October 2026. Welcome page: who the book is for and how it teaches, rewritten.
- 30 October 2026. Appendices: updated setup instructions and package lists, revised notation, and a step-by-step derivation of the variance of a dependent average.
- 30 October 2026. Chapters 4 and 5: clearer exercise instructions and stronger simulation comparisons.
:::

## Version 0.1 (30 October 2026) {.unnumbered}

Released 30 October 2026.

First release. Contents:

- The welcome page.
- Chapter 1, Probability and Simulation.
- Chapter 2, Bayesian Inference, Revisited.
- Chapter 3, Markov Chains.
- Chapter 4, Diagnosing Markov Chains.
- Chapter 5, The Metropolis Algorithm.
- Appendices A to D: software setup, notation, technical notes on MCMC, and conjugate-posterior derivations.
